text:
Sofia (Release): kicking off ebb/flow gating for v2.14.2 — doing region-by-region traffic handoff US -> EU -> APAC. change window 02:00-05:00 UTC. can SRE confirm capacity knobs?

deploy-bot: deploy initiated for service=inference-api image=redwood/inference:v2.14.2 shard=global task=canary

Matt (SRE): copying the checklist — will run smoke and concurrency tests. target p99 <= 180ms, gpu util < 85% on canary pools.

Lee (Eng): running quick load slice for US canary (10%):
```
# k6 quick script
vus: 50
duration: 60s
endpoints: /v1/generate
```
results: p50 48ms, p95 120ms, p99 165ms, GPU util ~62% across pool-us-canary.

Anya (Product): release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.14.2 — highlights: latency regressed fixed, new batching heuristic, models swapped for long-context perf. watching for regressions in roundtrip-quality tests.

Matt (SRE): EU warmup next. will push 5% traffic, validate autoscaler and queue depth. if p99 > 220ms or gpu util>80% we hold.

Lee (Eng): EU warmup numbers: p99 190ms, gpu util 68%, observe some KV cache cold misses (spike at start). warming should help. pushing to 20% in 10m.

deploy-bot: traffic shift: region=EU from=0% to=20% by=2026-03-20T03:14:00Z

Sofia (Release): APAC planning — can we pre-pin APAC to v2.14.1 if we see saturation? what's the quick rollback plan?

Matt (SRE): rollback plan: 1) pin traffic routing at edge to v2.14.1 (config flag) 2) scale up dedicated canary nodes (if spare quota) 3) initiate full rollback to v2.14.1 image if metrics don't recover in 12m. will annotate runbook.

Ops Oncall: quick capacity snapshot for apac region pools:
```
apac-primary: total gpus=40, used=36 (90%), spare-nodes=1
apac-burst: total gpus=24, used=21 (87%)
queued-reqs: 8
```

Lee (Eng): hmm APAC looks tight. we should avoid big traffic jumps. propose soft-gate: APAC start at 3%, observe 15m, then 10%, then 25% if stable. also enable aggressive batching for APAC slice via `batch_profile=latency_aware` to shave 10-15% cost.

Sofia (Release): agreed. pin policy ready: if any of these hit — p99>230ms for 6m, gpu util>88% for 5m, queue depth >20 — we auto-pin APAC to v2.14.1 and open incident channel.

Matt (SRE): implementing alerting thresholds now. enabling canary fallback: `rollout.fallback.enabled=true` and webhook to #incidents.

deploy-bot: rollout checkpoint reached: US=100% ok, EU=20% stable, APAC=3% initiated

Sofia (Release): final checks — has compliance gated the config? Anya?

Anya (Product): compliance confirmed for config changes. external release notes scheduled, marketing notified for rollback wording.

Ops Oncall: APAC after 10m at 3%: p99 210ms, gpu util 86%, queued-reqs 5. not ideal but within hold thresholds. continuing to 10% in 8m.

Matt (SRE): small config tweak — reduce `max_concurrent_requests` on apac-edge from 400->320 to ease queueing. pushing now.

Lee (Eng): tweak applied. metrics trending down: queued-reqs -> 2, p99 -> 198ms. looks safe to step to 10%.

deploy-bot: traffic shift: region=APAC from=3% to=10% by=2026-03-20T04:12:00Z

Sofia (Release): thanks team. leaving the soft-gate and pin thresholds as written. if anything crosses thresholds, Matt to announce immediate pin. i will update the release thread and notify customers in the status page. :thumbsup:

Matt (SRE): noted. standing by.

deploy-bot: rollout complete for v2.14.2 where regions=US:100%, EU:20% (gradual), APAC:10% (soft-gated)

Sofia (Release): closing thread — capture notes in the release playbook and add the APAC capacity shortfall to backlog for infra quota request.

Anya (Product): filed backlog ticket: INFRA-1842 — APAC dedicated capacity request.

Lee (Eng): nice work everyone.
